item.title: Bagent to start Saturday as Bears rest several starters
item.description: FGB brief: Tyson Bagent is set to start against Cleveland while Caleb Williams and several Bears starters are expected to sit.

item.title: Bears say stadium planning is focused on Hammond, Indiana
item.description: FGB brief: Bears leadership says current stadium planning is centered on Hammond while the franchise intends to remain the Chicago Bears.

item.title: Bears host Browns Saturday in 2026 preseason opener
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago opens its 2026 preseason schedule at Soldier Field against Cleveland on Saturday, August 15.
